subject: [PATCH 2/2] mm/mempolicy: limit shared policy ranges per inode

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Raised concerns that the patch may break userspace due to unexpected ENOMEMs when setting >1024 ranges, and suggested using max_map_count directly instead of introducing a new toggle.

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Defended the patch, arguing that it's reasonable to limit shared policy ranges and suggesting that userspace breakage is unlikely. Also proposed using max_map_count directly as an alternative solution.

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Reiterated the need for a more elegant solution and suggested using max_map_count directly to avoid introducing a new toggle.

2026-11-14.patch_summary: Proposal to limit shared policy ranges per inode in the mm/mempolicy module, sparking debate about potential userspace breakage and the need for a more elegant solution.
